description: Shared structural pattern for Login and Register — a centered, form-width-capped card with a minimal header, used because neither screen has any showcase mockup (design-to-code/screens/login.json, register.json).
structure: minimal header — logo/wordmark only, no nav link row
widthRule: form-width cap at every breakpoint (RESPONSIVE_BEHAVIOR.md § 4 form-width-cap logic) — never stretches full-bleed on wide viewports
